method: Fidelity evidence from interviews and document review was interpreted with a Homeless Link scoring guide (p.16, PDF 20); the internal self-assessments of GMHF and LCRCA report scores per principle (p.46, PDF 50). Scores are reported only as 'score highly'.

Survey changes in service use and WEMWBS scores valued with public service unit costs and published wellbeing values, then reduced by 15% (negative outcomes) and 30% (non-additionality) (p.54-56, PDF 58-60).
Published transfer values for secure housing applied per person supported; 15% deduction for negative outcomes 'based on 3-year outcomes data' and 30% for non-additionality (p.55-56, PDF 59-60).
Annual benefits per client divided by annual cost per client on the programme (Table 5.5, p.57, PDF 61).
